Clean rooms, polite staff, and a comfortable stay make this hotel a good choice for travelers. The location is convenient and the overall experience is smooth and pleasant. I also recommend a Google 360° Virtual Tour to showcase the hotel interiors on Google Maps and attract more guests.
— Karan Singh, Google Local Guide & Google-trusted 360° Virtual Tour Photographer

We visited to delhi for friends marriage ceremony and stayed in this hotel for 2 nights. Behaviour of staff at desk was good. Though checking time is  12.00 at noon but they allowed us for very early checking (around 8.30 am) without any questing. Rooms were not so bad its just ok ok type. If you are staying for one or two night then you can go for this hotel. Rooms were not so large. Ac was there but it was window AC and to some extend broken. Bathroom was large enough and clean but shower was broken. Gate  of the bathroom was not closing properly. Hotel room was quite silent. It is very close to main road easily you can get auto or cab.

Very good and economical hotel to stay. Very helpful staff. Stayed fox six days. Everything is good including food. Only drawback is upto morning 10, you will never get tea atleast. But after that, you can get all food until night 1100 . If you have morning patiennce, it's a good place.
